defense_news.title: US Air Force awards Lockheed Martin $694M hypersonic missile production contract
defense_news.summary: The Air Force granted Lockheed Martin a $694 million contract in late September for the production and fielding of the AGM-183A Air-Launched Rapid Response Weapon, or ARRW.

defense_news.title: US Army queries industry’s ability to build 21,000 Infantry Squad Vehicles
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Army published a market survey Monday in an effort to learn whether the defense industrial base could deliver 9,000 ISV-9s and about 12,000 ISV-Us.

defense_news.title: US Army looks to high-flying balloons to help see, strike along front lines with China
defense_news.summary: Amid renewed interest in high-altitude balloons, soldiers are looking to them to extend their reach along the first island chain.
